description: 1,748 Namer APCs on the GCV's procurement schedule (pp. 2, 20): 68 to 70 tons, 9 passengers. The best protected vehicle CBO examined (p. 24) and the least lethal — its largest weapon is a 12.7 mm machine gun (p. 25; described as its primary weapon at p. 23). Programmatic risk: Low.
name: Option 1: purchase the Israeli Namer armored personnel carrier
